Oracle Fusion 26D opt-in features: all 89, by module

Oracle's 26D What's New documents list 89 features you have to opt in to before anyone can use them: 47 marked "Opt In" and 42 marked "Opt In plus Setup". By area: 10 in Financials, 12 in Procurement, 64 in Supply Chain & Manufacturing, 2 in Project Management and 1 in HCM. Nothing below changes for your users until you opt in.

Every row comes from the Feature Summary tables in Oracle's 26D What's New documents, with Oracle's own "Impact to Existing Processes" and "Action to Enable" columns as Oracle states them. Each title links to Oracle's feature page. Oracle can revise its documents; we recheck them every week. Always confirm on the linked Oracle page.

How to use this list

  • Shortlist the opt-ins your business owners asked for, and read each one's Oracle page for prerequisites and setup steps.
  • Opt in and set up in a test environment first, then test the end-to-end flow the feature touches.
  • "Opt In plus Setup" features need configuration after the opt-in, so plan time for both.
  • Some of today's opt-ins later become standard features. Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list says which, and when.

Frequently asked questions

How many 26D features need an opt-in?

89 of the 768 features in Oracle's 26D What's New documents for the modules we cover: 47 are "Opt In" and 42 are "Opt In plus Setup", per Oracle's Action to Enable column.

Do 26D opt-in features change anything for users if I do nothing?

No. Per Oracle's Action to Enable column, these features stay off until you opt in, and "Opt In plus Setup" features also need configuration before anyone can use them.

Is this the same as the opt-in expiration list?

No. This page lists new 26D features you can choose to switch on. The 26D opt-in expiration list is Oracle's list of older opt-ins that become standard features with 26D.
